newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore trade in arbitrage play for RSS3 rubber.
newsitem.headline: Singapore trade in arbitrage play for RSS3 rubber.

text.p: Trading houses here were engaged in moderate buying of RSS3 grade rubber on Wednesday as they tried to take advantage of the arbitrage between the Singapore and Japanese rubber markets, dealers said.

"The foreign rubber houses were buying RSS3 rubber here and will try to sell them in Tokyo to take advantage of the arbitrage between the two markets. That's what generated the buying for RSS3," a dealer said.
"I was looking to buy RSS3 at 113.00 to 113.50 (U.S. cents a kg), but the offer was too high at 114.00 cents. It looks like most of the buying was done by Japanese houses," a trader said.
There was also some long liquidation seen in the market here after prices in Tokyo fell sharply due to the steep rise of the yen, dealers said.
"The fall in Japan caused some long liquidation although most of the action was probably to take advantage of the arbitrage between the market here and in Japan," a dealer said.

At 0945 GMT, July RSS3 was seen at 112.00-113.00 U.S. cents a kg from 114.50 cents. August RSS1 was seen at 162.00-164.00 Singapore cents (US$1.14-$1.15) a kg from 164.00 cents. July TSR20 was seen at 148.00 Singapore cents (US$1.04) a kg from 148.50 cents. - (S$1.42 = US$1) Rene Pastor (65-8703305)
